evidence: Repeated project iterations showed that a previously corrected implementation can regress when later work recreates an older assumption instead of preserving the verified baseline.
plannedProjectAdoption.lesson: When a correction has been explicitly accepted and subsequently verified, treat the corrected behavior as the current baseline. Do not reintroduce the superseded behavior unless newer evidence or a higher-priority instruction requires it.
plannedProjectAdoption.title: Preserve verified corrections as the active baseline

evidence: The internal ARAMF directory rename was initially described from the wrong path perspective; inspecting the repository root showed that ./ARAMF/ was the actual directory to rename while generated <ProjectPath>/ARAMF/ had to remain unchanged.
plannedProjectAdoption.lesson: Before changing or documenting repository paths, inspect the actual tree and resolve paths relative to the agent's current repository working root. Keep repository-internal setup paths distinct from generated target-project control-plane paths.
plannedProjectAdoption.title: Resolve repository paths from the actual working root

evidence: TEST-198: Generate and Verify passed with Memory excluded; Finalize initially failed on unconditional memory validation.
TEST-204: Same selective-generation failure pattern; passed after the correction.
TEST-210: Same selective-generation failure pattern; passed after the correction.
Correction gated memory-related Finalize requirements on the selected Memory product; all three retests passed with no recurrence.
plannedProjectAdoption.lesson: Lifecycle preconditions must be derived from the explicitly selected product set. Optional products must not introduce mandatory lifecycle requirements when they were intentionally excluded.
plannedProjectAdoption.title: Selected products define lifecycle preconditions

evidence: 2026-08-23: felciterad Windows cmd.exe rmdir /s /q-operation breddade målomfattningen och raderade orelaterade ARAMF- och PVD-arbetsytor; återställning från GitHub krävdes. Regeln har därefter lagts i AGENTS.md och den kanoniska instruktionstexten.
plannedProjectAdoption.lesson: TOP PRIORITY: ARAMF-agenter och verktyg får aldrig använda rekursiv shell-radering för städning eller borttagning av fixtures. Detta inkluderar cmd.exe /c rmdir /s /q, rd /s /q, PowerShell Remove-Item -Recurse, Unix rm -rf och motsvarande. Repositories, projektro¨tter, ARAMF_WORKER, build-träd och genererad persistent state får aldrig raderas för cleanup. Vid behov ska exakta mål verifieras och en icke-destruktiv, återställningsbar metod användas.
plannedProjectAdoption.title: TOP PRIORITY: Förbud mot destruktiv rekursiv städning

evidence: Explicit user-approved PVD mandatory GUI end-to-end testing policy; normal Framework Knowledge workflow.
plannedProjectAdoption.lesson: For Pico Visual Designer functionality exposed through the GUI, core, unit, service, generator, backend, and build PASS results remain valuable but are not application-level certification. Core PASS != GUI PASS and Build PASS != Application Certification PASS. Application certification must use the real visible PVD user workflow to the furthest supported stage: launch the actual executable where practical, wait for MainWindow, navigate workflow, select component and physical pin, select function, configure visible controls, verify transitions and stale-state absence, Generate, Configure, Build, Transfer, Runtime, and Debug where technically possible. Do not substitute project-model, backend, service, or generator calls for GUI actions; GUI Build, Transfer, and Debug must use normal application controls when available. Verify each transition and report the earliest failure boundary; later stages are NOT RUN after a blocking failure. Use distinct results PASS-CORE, PASS-GUI, PASS-GENERATE, PASS-CONFIGURE, PASS-BUILD, PASS-TRANSFER, PASS-RUNTIME, PASS-DEBUG, PASS-AUTOMATED, PASS-PHYSICAL, NOT-TESTED, NOT-APPLICABLE, REQUIRES-EXTERNAL-HARDWARE, and FAIL. Software or debugger evidence must not claim physical or electrical certification. Current automation must not require new wiring or external hardware; physical certification is later. Include periodic real cold-start coverage and deterministic safe isolation. Cleanup remains subject to the TOP PRIORITY prohibition on broad recursive deletion, including rmdir /s /q, rd /s /q, Remove-Item -Recurse, rm -rf, and equivalents; use narrow recoverable cleanup. Keep unrelated future improvements in the ARAMF Improvement Backlog. This policy is PVD-specific and does not make unrelated projects subject to GUI certification.
plannedProjectAdoption.title: PVD mandatory GUI end-to-end certification
